name: dex-labs
description: DEX Labs - a personal local-network site with pluggable subsystems: Lesson Tracker (YouTube lessons + tute files by subject/grade), AirDrop (LAN file share), Daily Schedule, Clock (Timer/Alarm/Stopwatch/Events), a YouTube Downloader, Study (subjects, Stopwatch/Pomodoro focus sessions, stats, a year heatmap), To-Do (a tick-off list you can schedule on calendar days and see in Standby Mode), Standby Mode, and CCTV (live feeds from a Hikvision DVR on your WiFi, no login needed). Runs as a Windows system tray application.
